compact_press.width_selection: fixed; --size is recorded and does not change layer widths

authority.selection: enabled flags select v4 changes; disabled components retain v3 formulas

fixed.control: original position LH21 native range and4rad/s; no injected targets
fixed.positive_failure_tick: suppressed by existing completed control boundary

timing.gate: original score gate; first selected global earliest-press group protected from reset through own end
timing.unchanged: original release grace, gap lead, fade, early goal exposure and2s lookahead
timing.tracking: potential multiplied by1-final standby reward gate

posture.budget: 0.02/s mean4; maximum0.005/s per finger; no active posture cost

reach.budget: bounded potential, not cumulative reward budget

alignment.spacing: nearest adjacent physical string at selected fret-cell center y, projected in press plane perpendicular to target string
alignment.unchanged: along-cell excess, normal factor and quintic descent blend; no hard gate

compact_press_v4.invalid: nonfinite or invalid geometry has zero positive potential; never NaN multiplied by masked zero; baseline matches finite v3 inputs, invalid-zero is an intentional exception

diagnostics.gate: actual standby_reward_gate; legacy score and original E4 gates separately recorded
diagnostics.reset: selected episode rows only; H32 boundary preserves statistics
diagnostics.alignment: hover-ready: valid target, height4..8mm, cell-along excess<=1e-6m, lateral<=profile tolerance, normal cosine>=0.1
diagnostics.angles: actual parent-child geometric flexion, degrees; not native MCP x/z coordinates
diagnostics.phases: all, actual standby gate-weighted, pressing score interval, preparing exposed goal; may overlap
diagnostics.payment: legacy parent weighted_standby_reward uses actual failure-suppressed payout; opportunity is not paid reward

authority.inherited: reward.compact_press_v4 and inherited v3 descriptions are reference where overridden; other v4 combined components unchanged

observation.next_press: minimum strictly future press>score_time among actual recovery_mask, including unselected boundary notes
observation.invalid_next_press: delta0 and valid0; active or first-protected state is represented by actual gate
observation.next_press_scale: fixed max(full task duration_s,1) seconds; normalized clip[-10,10]
observation.budget_scale: fixed0.25*full task target count, positive; not selected-view count; clip[-10,10]
observation.velocity: negative physical chosen pad-point relative velocity in moving guitar frame; not exact derivative of nearest-point error

preparation.potential: same bounded v4 combined quality and gamma difference; no extra reward or control override

full_hold.application: existing achievement latch/bonus and performance deficit settlement; budgets unchanged

completion.hold: existing v3 full-note and simultaneous strict holds preserved
completion.release: original release_required; separate raw contact_loaded_target True-to-False latch in inclusive[end,end+0.1s]; legacy clean-candidate release ledger preserved
completion.release_scope: loss of target pad geometry/facing/load candidate; not contact-pair separation, pressure or physical complete detachment; wrong-only changes do not count
completion.exception: continuous same string/fret/finger next onset at current end does not require intermediate release, using original full-score release_required
completion.success: safe complete selected timeline AND strict full hold AND every required release; no pending/aborted success

checkpoints.scope: all successful initial/periodic/final/recovery saves, including checkpoint fsync; save_s excludes manifest hashing/write

guitar_representation.proxy_collision_policy: G:thumb_support_proxy and G:pluck_range retain visuals and their original mass/COM/inertia contribution, but both geoms have contype=conaffinity=0.
